evaluation.rationale: The notes suffer from severe structural and logical issues. They repeat the same information across multiple redundant sections (e.g., 'Action items' and 'Action items (structured)'). More critically, the notes fail to distinguish between initial proposals and final decisions, presenting superseded values (like the October 16-19 dates, Priya booking the cabin, and the $285 cost split) as final decisions alongside the actual final values. This creates massive contradictions throughout the text. There are also hallucinated action items, such as Dan sending Priya $190 instead of the other way around, and the summary contains a cut-off sentence.
